dz: 格拉提安皇帝将基尔米乌斯的弗拉维乌斯·西奥多修斯升格为奥古斯都,并赋予他罗马帝国所有东部行省的权力.
de: Emperor Gratian elevates Flavius Theodosius at Sirmium to Augustus, and gives him authority over all the eastern provinces of the Roman Empire.
